product.olivetti-m28-20.summary: The 20 MB M28 configuration with a hard disk and monochrome monitor as standard.
product.olivetti-m28-20.history: The Dutch brochure placed the M28/20 among the M28 professional configurations. The bundle included a 20 MB hard disk and a monochrome monitor.
product.olivetti-m28-20.architecture: Working memory could be expanded on the board. The brochure specifies 512 KB base memory and up to 1 MB on the system board.
product.olivetti-m28-20.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m28-20.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
